question: Which 5 nations had the longest life expectancy in 2018?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT entity, life_expectancy FROM DATAMIND.OWID.life_expectancy WHERE year = 2018 AND code IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(code,5) <> 'OWID_' ORDER BY life_expectancy DESC, entity ASC LIMIT 5;

question: who are the top 5 customers by total discounted line-item spend?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.C_CUSTKEY, c.C_NAME, SUM(l.L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - l.L_DISCOUNT)) AS total_spend FROM SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.CUSTOMER c JOIN SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.ORDERS o ON c.C_CUSTKEY = o.O_CUSTKEY JOIN SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.LINEITEM l ON o.O_ORDERKEY = l.L_ORDERKEY GROUP BY c.C_CUSTKEY, c.C_NAME ORDER BY total_spend DESC, c.C_CUSTKEY ASC LIMIT 5;

question: what is the total discounted line-item revenue by customers' nation?

question: what is the total discounted line-item revenue by customers' region?

question: what are the top 10 countries by life expectancy improvement between 2000 and 2019?
ground_truth_sql: WITH le_2000 AS (SELECT entity, life_expectancy AS le_2000 FROM DATAMIND.OWID.life_expectancy WHERE year = 2000 AND code IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(code,5) <> 'OWID_'), le_2019 AS (SELECT entity, life_expectancy AS le_2019 FROM DATAMIND.OWID.life_expectancy WHERE year = 2019 AND code IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(code,5) <> 'OWID_') SELECT a.entity, (b.le_2019 - a.le_2000) AS improvement FROM le_2000 a JOIN le_2019 b ON a.entity = b.entity ORDER BY improvement DESC, a.entity ASC LIMIT 10;

question: who are the 20 highest-spending customers whose total discounted line-item spend is above the average customer spend among customers with orders?
ground_truth_sql: WITH cust_totals AS (SELECT o.O_CUSTKEY, SUM(l.L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - l.L_DISCOUNT)) AS total_spend FROM SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.ORDERS o JOIN SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.LINEITEM l ON o.O_ORDERKEY = l.L_ORDERKEY GROUP BY o.O_CUSTKEY), avg_spend AS (SELECT AVG(total_spend) AS mean_spend FROM cust_totals) SELECT c.C_CUSTKEY, c.C_NAME, ct.total_spend FROM SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.CUSTOMER c JOIN cust_totals ct ON c.C_CUSTKEY = ct.O_CUSTKEY JOIN avg_spend a ON ct.total_spend > a.mean_spend ORDER BY ct.total_spend DESC, c.C_CUSTKEY ASC LIMIT 20;

question: which nations have more suppliers than the average nation?
ground_truth_sql: WITH nation_counts AS (SELECT S_NATIONKEY, COUNT(*) AS supp_count FROM SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.SUPPLIER GROUP BY S_NATIONKEY), avg_cnt AS (SELECT AVG(supp_count) AS mean_count FROM nation_counts) SELECT n.N_NAME, nc.supp_count FROM SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.NATION n JOIN nation_counts nc ON n.N_NATIONKEY = nc.S_NATIONKEY JOIN avg_cnt a ON nc.supp_count > a.mean_count ORDER BY nc.supp_count DESC, n.N_NAME ASC;

question: which month in 1995 generated the highest total discounted line-item revenue?
ground_truth_sql: WITH monthly_rev AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.O_ORDERDATE) AS order_month, SUM(l.L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - l.L_DISCOUNT)) AS month_revenue FROM SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.ORDERS o JOIN SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.LINEITEM l ON o.O_ORDERKEY = l.L_ORDERKEY WHERE YEAR(o.O_ORDERDATE) = 1995 GROUP BY order_month) SELECT order_month, month_revenue FROM monthly_rev ORDER BY month_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: change in life expectancy for Japan each year from 2011 to 2019 compared with the year before
ground_truth_sql: WITH japan_le AS (SELECT year, life_expectancy FROM DATAMIND.OWID.life_expectancy WHERE entity = 'Japan' AND year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2019), yoy AS (SELECT year, life_expectancy, LAG(life_expectancy) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS prev_le FROM japan_le) SELECT year, (life_expectancy - prev_le) AS yoy_change FROM yoy WHERE prev_le IS NOT NULL ORDER BY year ASC;
